E5-1.claim: every run: invariant_failures empty and gpu_only_lease_slots 0; no run of an ok job lost to an error

E5-2.claim: long menu: A6-rule and A6-always2 have n_exp_total 0 and buys 0 in every run whose instance has max_l lam_s[j, l] <= 3600 s for every LLM j (contracts with H_k >= lambda_min never create exposure, design §3.2.6); runs of an instance above the limit are listed and not checked

E5-3.claim: A6-always2: every run with n_exp_total > 0 has buys + no_site > 0 (a spare whenever a group has an exposed replica, or no site for one; design §3.2.6)

E5-4.claim: per (level, menu): the BL3 variants whose median cost over BL0a and median fallback share after reclaims are both below those of every A6 mode (Pareto gains; design §5.5 E5, reading), the long menu reported separately (informative)
E5-4.a6_identical_rule: cells (level, menu) at mu = 1 where the three A6 modes gave the same run for every (alignment, policy seed): there E5-4 compares BL3 with one A6 policy

E5-5.claim: every Sublet run: certificate held in Theorem W's proven cases (W(a), W(b); PROVEN for the engine as implemented under C1-C3, audited); W(c) runs (CONJECTURE) counted; no Sublet run lost to an error

E5-6.claim: the share of A6-rule runs that bought a spare, per (level, menu) over every mu / beta~ of the point and per mu (by_mu), against the rule's prediction (spares only for pools above about 32 exposed replicas at alpha = 0.40; a5b_exposure_thresholds.json spare_threshold) (informative)

threshold.rule: spare pays if n_exp > alpha / (nu lambda) (design §3.2.6)

E5-6.prediction: spares only where a pool has more than n_exp_threshold exposed replicas (at alpha and lambda of a5b's spare_threshold); counts per run of buys > 0 against n_exp_max above or below that threshold, n_exp_max being the largest number of exposed replicas in one slot summed over the run's groups (RedundancyRule.n_exp), an upper bound on any one pool's count
